env_files.role: Official Bio-Rad manual containing the full antigen-detection procedure, safety guidance, other ELISA protocols, instructor material, questions, extensions, and natural distractors.
env_files.conversion_note: The ready-made Protocol I quick-guide pages remain removed; detailed procedure content remains.

env_files.role: Official teaching deck used to corroborate assay order, controls, washes, and color development while retaining unrelated modeling and protocol distractors.
env_files.conversion_note: The unrelated antibody-detection animation page and embedded 58 MB video remain removed.

env_files.role: Benchmark-authored controlled workbook for schedule, room status, change log, station assignments, exchange routes, station-kit releases, and bulletin release status.
env_files.reproducibility_note: Contains seven worksheets and roughly 2,200 operational rows. The active answer requires matching exact session/station keys, latest effective approved replacements, Released routes/kits, and document-control precedence.

env_files.role: Benchmark-authored 700-row lot ledger used to validate assigned reagent packs, expiry/protocol/station scope, lot-specific substrate timing, issue increment, and dead volume.
env_files.reproducibility_note: Includes released, pending, quarantined, expired, superseded, and protocol-mismatched lots without a precomputed station answer.

env_files.role: Versioned rule text for OPS-27, OPS-30, and station-specific OPS-34 plus obsolete/pending pilot distractors.
env_files.reproducibility_note: The workbook release register controls current status; bulletin prose controls topic-specific rules. Derived quantities are not precomputed.

source_policy.web_usage_note: Closed-env case; use only task.md and env/.

design_notes.task_alignment: The case remains a procedure-to-bench-card task. Difficulty is increased through normal laboratory document control, roster replacement, route translation, kit/lot validation, and operational calculations.
design_notes.difficulty_upgrade: Data volume rises from about 320 to more than 2,900 structured records. Correct completion requires interactions across schedule/change records, per-seat replacement logic, a three-round exchange route, document release status, station-kit release, lot QC, and reserve/dead-volume/rounding calculations.
design_notes.fairness: Each grounded VQA tests one coherent operational decision with about two to four logical groups. A single minor omission normally yields 1 rather than 0; 0 is reserved for a wrong core decision, unsafe contradiction, obsolete record, or multiple missing groups.
design_notes.leakage_control: No precomputed active roster summary, token route, lot set, timing total, wash total, dispense total, or issue amount is exposed as an answer table.
design_notes.natural_distractors: Other sessions/stations, superseded seat D, pending routes and kits, obsolete bulletins, unapproved pilots, expired/quarantined lots, instructor records, other protocols, and optional manual content.
design_notes.calibration_intent: Target strong-agent scores around 20-40 by increasing retrieval and cross-source reconciliation difficulty rather than using giant all-or-zero checklists.
